ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The diagram shows the __________________ of a Monarch Butterfly
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows four stages of a monarch butterfly arranged around a dotted circular arrow. The pictures include an adult monarch butterfly, a white egg on a leaf, a green chrysalis/pupa, and a striped caterpillar/larva. The circular arrows indicate these stages repeat in order. Reasoning: A circular sequence from egg to caterpillar to chrysalis to adult butterfly is called a life cycle. Therefore, the diagram shows the life cycle of a Monarch Butterfly.
